title: WhatsApp Flow
summary: WhatsApp automation is about consent — not spam.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** WhatsApp automation for confirmations and FAQs — confidently and with **consent**.
- **Why now?** After **lead capture** — the closest channel to the customer.
bullets: **What will you understand?** WhatsApp automation for confirmations and FAQs — confidently and with **consent**.
**Why now?** After **lead capture** — the closest channel to the customer.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: Bot Response — Customer Feels Annoyed
sections.contentMarkdown: - Mass messaging → block and reports. WhatsApp is a personal channel.
bullets: Mass messaging → block and reports. WhatsApp is a personal channel.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Helpful Response + **Handoff**
sections.contentMarkdown:
- The customer initiates or agrees — no random broadcasting.
- Message → understanding → response → if complicated: handoff to a staff member.
bullets: The customer initiates or agrees — no random broadcasting.
Message → understanding → response → if complicated: handoff to a staff member.
